senses.gloss: naiḥsargika, adj. (= niḥsargika, q.v.; also written naisar˚), involving forfeiture: ˚kāpattiḥ Mvy 〔9309〕 (text nai-sa˚, Index naiḥs˚, so Mironov with v.l. nai-sa˚); ˚kāḥ pāyattikāḥ (see this; in Pali the corresponding pācittiya offenses include the nissaggiya) Mvy 〔8383〕; in both Tib. spaṅ ba, giving up, renouncing, or the like; applied to robes (cīvarāṇi), subject to forfeiture: Divy 〔19.26〕 (here mss. nai-sa˚); 〔21.21〕.

naiḥsvabhāvya, naiḥsvā˚, nt. (to Skt. niḥsvabhāva plus -ya), state of having no essence; only in vss, but quantity of 2d syllable indifferent: ˚sva˚ Laṅk 〔274.3〕; 〔295.10〕; 〔311.6〕; 〔336.2〕; ˚svā˚ 〔266.12〕; 〔280.15〕.
